title: Sudan, Republic. An Order Of Civil Accomplishment, By Spink & Son
description: In bronze gilt with green and white enamels, silvered disk bearing the Sudanese coat-of-arms, measuring 95.5 mm (w) x 109.8 mm (h) inclusive of its coat-of-arms disk suspension and integral ring, one tiny chip in the white enamels on the centrepiece insignia, otherwise the enamels are intact, original ribbon, near extremely fine. Footnote: The Order of Civil Accomplishment is awarded to any governmental unit or administration, public organization or corporation or company of the public sector which accomplishes any great achievements in any civil field, which lead to the development and progress of the civil service.

title: Sudan, Republic. Order of the Two Niles, I. Class Grand Badge, by Spink & Son Ltd, c.1965
description: (Wisām an-Nīlayni). Instituted November 16th, 1961. (c. 1965 issue). A cased Order of the Two Niles, I.
